sources: https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/dcgm/latest/release-notes/dcgm-exporter.html (fetched 2026-11-11: newest section listed was 4.8.4, so the 4.9.0 upgrade checklist could not be read there)
summary: 23 default and profiling-preset fields renamed (incl. the driver-version label); 11 of them change unit. FB_CAPACITY_BYTES is a new default. Pod per-process GPU util and memory are emitted under both old and new names. dcp-metrics-included.csv and 1.x-compatibility-metrics.csv are deprecated in favour of default-counters.csv.
